landing.skipHint: Skip the introduction and sign in
landing.signInHint: Your family can help you sign in the first time.
landing.signInFailed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.

today.title: Your day, one thing at a time
today.body: Reminders and medicines arrive in order, with a single large button to mark each one done.

people.title: The people who matter, always close
people.body: Faces and names you can tap to call, so no one is ever more than one touch away.

memories.title: Memories, kept where you can find them
memories.body: Photos and moments your family shares land here, ready to look back on any time.

help.title: Help, the moment you need it
help.body: One tap reaches the person you trust most — day or night, wherever you are.

recall.question: What is your name?
recall.hint: One letter at a time. No rush.
recall.progressLabel: How much of your name is right
recall.placed_one: {{correct}} in place, {{count}} in the wrong spot
recall.placed_other: {{correct}} in place, {{count}} in the wrong spot
recall.revealed: Your name is {{name}}. Type it in to carry on.

setup.title: Who looks after you?
setup.body: Ask the person who helps you for their Smaran number. It has nine numbers, and they will find it in their own app.
setup.submit: Ask them to look after me
setup.reassurance: They will see your request and say yes. Nothing is shared until they do.
setup.waitingBody: This page will open on its own as soon as they say yes. You can leave it here.
setup.waitingBodyNumber: We asked the person with the number {{number}}. This page will open on its own as soon as they say yes.

failure.unknown-number: We could not find that number. Please check it with the person who gave it to you.
failure.offline: The phone is not connected right now. Please try again in a little while.
failure.failed: That did not work just now. Please try again.
failure.deregistered: This caregiver has deregistered your account. You cannot link with this code again.

today.nextUpPlaceholder: Nothing to do just now. Anything added below shows up here first.
today.emptyMessage: Your day is clear. Add a reminder below and it will be here every day.

add.title: Add a reminder
add.message: It will be here on this page at the time you choose, on the days you choose.
add.nameHint: A few words, like “Take the blue tablet”.

games.title: Games
games.subtitle: Small things to do that keep the mind moving. No timer, and nothing to lose.
games.moreTitle: More games are on the way
games.moreMessage: New games will appear on this list as they are ready. Every one of them works with no signal.

home.description: A few gentle games, whenever you feel like playing one.
home.allHint: See every game there is, including the ones you have not played yet.

matching.name: Matching pairs
matching.shortDescription: Turn two cards over and find the pairs.
matching.previewBody: Have a good look. The cards turn over in a moment.
matching.previewLabel: How much longer the cards stay face up
matching.progressLabel: How many pairs you have found
matching.pairFound: That is a pair. They stay face up.
matching.notAPair: Those two are different. They will turn back over.
matching.doneMessage_one: You found the pair on this board.
matching.doneMessage_other: You found all {{count}} pairs on this board.

reason.firstBoard: A gentle board to begin with.
reason.easy: That went quicker than your own last few rounds, so there is a bigger board ready if you would like it.
reason.steady: That went much like your own last few rounds — this board suits you nicely.
reason.hard: That board asked a lot this time, so here is a gentler one. There is no hurry at all.
reason.topBoard: That went quicker than your own last few rounds, and this is the biggest board there is.
reason.gentlest: This is the gentlest board there is, and it is a good one to stay with.

missing.name: Find what is missing
missing.shortDescription: Look at the things, then say which one has gone.
missing.studyBody_one: Have a good look. One of these will go away in a moment.
missing.studyBody_other: Have a good look. {{count}} of these will go away in a moment.
missing.studyLabel: How much longer the things stay on screen
missing.progressLabel: How many of the missing things you have named
missing.ask_one: One thing is missing. Which one?
missing.ask_other: {{count}} things are missing. Which one has gone?
missing.optionsLabel: Choose the one that is missing
missing.found: Yes — {{name}} was missing. It is back in its place.
missing.notThatOne: {{name}} was not one of them. Have another look.
missing.doneMessage_one: You found the one that was missing.
missing.doneMessage_other: You found all {{count}} that were missing.

recognise.name: People and places you know
recognise.shortDescription: Photographs your family shared, and a gentle question about each.
recognise.preparingBody: This takes a moment. There is nothing to do just now.
recognise.preparingAsking: We are writing some new questions about your photographs. This takes a moment, and the game works just as well without them.
recognise.preparingLabel: How much longer the game takes to get ready
recognise.progressLabel: How many questions you have answered
recognise.photoLabel: The photograph this question is about. Tap it to see it larger.
recognise.notThatOne: Not that one. Have another look — there is no hurry.
recognise.emptyTitle: There are no photographs here yet
recognise.emptyMessage: When your family adds people, places and things you know, this game will ask you about them. Nothing is missing on your side.
recognise.doneMessage_one: You answered the question on this board.
recognise.doneMessage_other: You answered all {{count}} questions on this board.

memories.title: Memories
memories.subtitle: Photos and moments your family shared.
memories.emptyMessage: Photos and stories shared with you will collect here, newest first.
memories.peopleSubtitle: Everyone your family added, newest first.
memories.placesSubtitle: The places your family added, newest first.
memories.objectsSubtitle: The things your family added, newest first.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Reach someone straight away, any time of day.
help.callHint: Call the person who looks after you
help.caregiverLabel: The person who looks after you
help.callNote: Press the green button and their phone will ring.
help.noContactMessage: The person who looks after you has not added their phone number. Once they add it to their Smaran account, it will show up here.
help.otherContactsDescription: People who can help when your first contact is busy.
help.backupMessage: Your family can add more people to call from the caregiver dashboard.

privacy.label: Privacy and security
privacy.body: Only the family members you have added can see your reminders and memories. Nobody else does, and nothing is shared outside the app.

helpCentre.label: Help centre
helpCentre.body: The Help tab calls someone who can help you, any time of day.

about.label: About Smaran
about.body: Smaran is made to be read easily and used slowly: large type, big buttons, and never more than a few choices at once.

update.label: Check for a newer Smaran
update.body: Smaran looks for a newer version by itself every time you open it. You can also ask right now — it takes a moment, and nothing on this phone changes unless you say yes afterwards.
update.current: This phone already has the newest Smaran.
update.available: There is a newer Smaran. The message on your screen will help you get it.
update.unavailable: Smaran could not ask just now. Nothing on this phone has changed.
update.unsupported: Smaran only updates itself on Android phones.
update.busy: Smaran is already getting an update.

refresh.label: Refresh this phone
refresh.description: Get everything again from your family
refresh.body: This clears the reminders, photographs and games kept on this phone, then fetches them again from your family. Nothing you have done is lost — it is sent on first, and comes straight back.
refresh.hint: Clear this phone and get everything again
refresh.confirmMessage: Smaran will clear what is kept here and get it all again from your family. This needs the internet, and takes a moment.
refresh.working: Getting everything again. Please wait a moment.
refresh.done: Done. Everything on this phone is up to date.
refresh.offline: Smaran could not reach your family just now, so nothing was changed. Please try again later.
refresh.unavailable: Smaran could not do that just now, so nothing was changed. Please try again later.

signOut.label: Sign out
signOut.description: Leave this account on this phone
signOut.body: You will need your email address to sign back in.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: How Smaran looks to you.
appearance.brightnessFollowing: Following your phone, which is {{scheme}} right now.
appearance.brightnessFixed: Set here, whatever your phone is doing.
appearance.textSizeDescription: Your phone's own text setting still applies on top of this.
appearance.highlightDescription: The colour Smaran uses for its buttons and for whatever you have chosen.
appearance.boldDescription: Thicker letters, without making them any bigger.
appearance.boldToggleDescription: Everything in Smaran is written a little heavier.
appearance.sampleBody: One tablet with breakfast. Meera will be told once you have marked it done.

system.label: My phone
system.description: Turns dark when your phone does.

light.label: Light
light.description: Dark text on a pale background.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Pale text on a dark background. Easier at night.

largest.label: Largest
largest.description: As big as Smaran goes. Fewer words fit on a screen.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The language Smaran speaks to you in.
language.chooseDescription: Everything changes straight away. You can come back and change it again whenever you like.
language.offlineBody: Every language is already on this phone. Changing it works with no signal, and nothing needs to be downloaded.
language.moreBody: Smaran will speak more languages of the North East as translations are checked by people who use them every day.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: How Smaran reminds you.
notifications.soundDescription: Played when a reminder is due.
notifications.soundBody: Reminders use your phone's default sound for now. A choice of sounds is coming.
notifications.repeatDescription: What happens when a reminder goes unanswered.
notifications.repeatBody: A reminder asks twice more, ten minutes apart, and then lets your family know it was missed.
notifications.quietBody: Nothing sounds between 10pm and 7am, except a call for help.

profile.title: Account
profile.subtitle: What Smaran knows about you. You can change it here.
profile.firstNameHint: The name Smaran greets you by.
profile.phoneHint: The number people can reach you on.
profile.emailFixed: Your email is how you sign in, so it stays as it is.
profile.photoDescription: Shown at the top of the Account tab.
profile.photoPending: This is your new photo. Save it to keep it.
profile.noPhotoAccess: Smaran needs your permission to open the camera or your photos. You can allow it in your phone's settings.
profile.saved: Saved. Your details are up to date.
profile.notSaved: Smaran could not save that just now. Try again when you are back online.
profile.wrongDescription: Anyone in your circle can help you change these.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page does not exist. Let's get you back to your day.

offered.title: A newer Smaran is ready
offered.message: There is a newer Smaran for this phone. Getting it takes a few minutes, and everything you have stays exactly as it is.

update.downloading: Smaran is getting version {{version}}. You can wait here, or come back to this later.
update.verifying: Smaran is checking that everything arrived safely.
update.installing: Almost there. Your phone will ask you to install Smaran — please say yes.
update.progressLabel: How much of the update has arrived
update.checkLabel: How much of the update has been checked

failed.unavailable: Smaran could not finish getting the update just now. Nothing on this phone has changed.
failed.corrupt: The update did not arrive properly, so Smaran did not install it. Nothing on this phone has changed.
failed.refused: Your phone did not let Smaran open the installer. You may need to allow Smaran to install apps.
